product_one_liner.value: PolyAI provides enterprises with voice and chat AI agents that handle customer-service conversations and tasks.
product_one_liner.notes: PolyAI documentation describes its platform as voice and chat agents completing real customer tasks and explicitly frames it as built for resolution.

pricing_page.notes: PolyAI has a public page titled “Pricing” with plan pricing information, including per-minute ongoing-use pricing.

founded_year.notes: PolyAI’s About page states “2017 Founded in,” directly giving the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog features an ASR-model fine-tuning post by a Machine Learning Engineer and a technical SageMaker/deployment post by PolyAI’s SVP of Engineering. These are at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product/model is built and deployed.

public_docs.notes: PolyAI provides a public documentation site with a quickstart and platform overview links, indicating multiple product documentation articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Greenhouse careers listing shows three roles, in Product, Marketing, and Account Management, and none has an AI/ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: A PolyAI job description says its agents are powered by Raven, described as PolyAI’s proprietary dialog model.
